This report is developed based upon funding from the Alliance for Sustainable Energy, LLC, Managing and Operating Contractor for the National Renewable Energy Laboratory for the U.S. Department of Energy. It develops and implements the Airport GSE Infrastructure & Logistics Electrification Assessment Tool (Agile@)–a strategic tool to model electricity demand for ground support equipment (GSE) at the Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) International Airport and assess its potential grid impact for GSE and drayage operations. The analysis draws on Agile@ modeling iterations and 2025 inbound/outbound freight data compiled by ORNL.
